Class King

java.lang.Object
ChessObject
King
All Implemented Interfaces:
ChessPiece
public class King extends ChessObject implements ChessPiece
This class represents a King chess piece. It offers all the operations mandated by the ChessPiece interface. It also extends the abstract class ChessObject and thus inherits all attributes offered by the abstract class.
